sources.title: Clearstory for Specialty Contractors
sources.finding: Clearstory describes field photos/signatures, T&M-to-change-order conversion, shared log via link, estimates and review. This is substantial overlap with R1-I-01; vendor outcome percentages are NOT independently validated.

sources.title: Opus1 makeup lessons setup
sources.finding: Make-up credits, self-booking, same-teacher restrictions, cancellation-only availability and policies exist. Occupied-slot multi-party exchanges were not established by this limited inspected page.

sources.title: Omaha Conservatory 2025-26 FAQ
sources.finding: School explicitly encourages students to arrange swaps with others in same studio when missing lessons; alternatives include virtual lessons/absence. School uses Opus1 and admissions updates schedules. Supports real workaround, not willingness to buy another tool.

sources.title: Claimlane furniture returns and claims
sources.finding: Claimlane describes guided self-service gathering photos/serial numbers and handling spare parts, repairs, technicians, refunds and returns, including complex furniture. Major overlap with R1-I-04.

sources.title: Ashley FAQ
sources.finding: Published policies include repair/replacement and return conditions by fulfillment/product context. Does not demonstrate adoption or pain of small SEA furniture sellers. No universal legal conclusion.

sources.title: How Swimm Auto-sync works
sources.date: Exact publication UNKNOWN; search index says older article
sources.finding: Swimm analyzes changed code and linked tokens/paths, automatically updates some snippets and asks humans to review others. Overlap with documentation invalidation mechanism; date/availability of exact current entitlement UNKNOWN.

sources.title: SurveyCTO collecting high-quality data
sources.finding: SurveyCTO documents automated checks, review/correction, automation of back-check workflow, random audits, exports and spreadsheet review. Major overlap with R1-I-07; not proof a targeted allocation niche cannot exist.

sources.title: Footwear BOM and material substitution approval
sources.type: supplier marketing guide; low evidential strength
sources.finding: Guide says preapproved alternatives must specify identities, scope, conditions and evidence; otherwise human review/approval. Sector differs from garments; cannot validate acceptance of generic substitution rules.

sources.title: Claira planning guides
sources.finding: Index includes group trip voting, dates, budgets, dealbreakers and decision guides. Shows closely adjacent positioning for R1-I-06, not verified end-to-end product capability.

sources.title: Godot docs issue 10020
sources.finding: Issue reports tutorial referencing deprecated call and mismatched screenshots; a later commenter reports more than four hours spent. Self-report, one selected OSS context, no commercial buyer proof.

sources.title: Besu docs issue 1035
sources.finding: Maintainer report describes config changes breaking a tutorial while URL still responds; proposes commit permalinks and scheduled checks. Evidence both of problem mechanism and cheap substitute, not current unmet demand.

sources.title: ABP AI Tutorial Validator
sources.finding: README describes executing public tutorials step by step, reporting failing steps and notifications. Strong direct substitute for a generic tutorial-testing product. Existence/described design verified; tool was not run.

sources.title: Claimlane Product Parts
sources.finding: Official help describes customer entering a part name, agent validation/enrichment with SKU/item identifiers, and optional product-to-parts catalogue relations/metafields. Example fields include itemNumber, ean, parentEan, sku, quantity. Direct overlap with part identification; integration not run.

sources.title: Faceworks phê duyệt phát sinh xây dựng
sources.finding: Vendor describes change requests, approval authority/value rules, links to budget/contract/acceptance and evidence. Vietnamese availability/marketing verified; usability, pricing, delivery and customer results not tested.

sources.title: Child music studio policy 2022-2023
sources.finding: Policy mentions My Music Staff calendar and arranging student swaps through the teacher for planned absence; old, selected example. Corroborates manual coordination workaround; not proof current unmet paid demand.

sources.title: Stundenplan-berechnen scheduling and lesson swap
sources.finding: Vendor broadly advertises students trading lesson slots with each other, but detailed bullets describe moving a booked lesson into a free offered slot. A later comparison again says peer swaps. Three-party occupied-slot cycles and actual behavior remain UNKNOWN; page wording is internally ambiguous. No product run.

sources.title: Prelude Studio parent resources
sources.finding: School publishes form -> swap list -> teacher/WhatsApp coordination for permanent or semi-permanent lesson changes, explicitly not weekly reschedules. Illustrates cheap workable substitute; does not validate weekly cycle demand. Irrelevant meeting credentials not retained or used.
